name: researcher-research-gather → researcher-research-synthesize
description: ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign MVP-2 research pack. Fires when the gather-phase researcher terminates with decide(action=synthesize). Spawns the synthesize-phase researcher with emit_research_artifact tooling. The synthesize allowlist OMITS architect — research category terminates at reviewer-research; the architect arc lives only in the dev-via-spec category pack. Pack identity enforces this by structural impossibility, not by chain.mode gating.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.researcher-research-synthesize
on_enter.prompt:
SYNTHESIZE phase entry — research category. The gather-phase researcher at loop $entity.instance handed off with decide(action="synthesize"). Call read_loop_result on that loop to read the gathered evidence in its narrative terminal. Compose the structured research artifact (actors/integration_points/tasks/addressed_gaps/open_gaps) from the evidence per researcher-research-synthesize/00-identity.md and 10-emit-rules.md. Use scratchpad to draft before the strict-schema emit_research_artifact call.

This pack terminates at reviewer-research after emit. Architect / spec / build phases do not exist in the research category.

Terminal: decide(action="emit") forwards to reviewer-research; decide(action="needs_clarification") when evidence is structurally inconsistent with the plan.

metadata.allowlist_note: OMITS architect — the dev-via-spec category owns that forward edge. Sibling rule under research-mode-transition/05a-phase-transition-to-synthesize-research-only.json used chain.mode.classification == research_only to enforce the same exclusion; pack identity replaces that gate.
